csv_project_name: A/E Service for Wake County Building Renovations
csv_scope_of_work: Wake County Government hereby requests qualifications from professional firms/ teams to provide architectural and engineering services involving modification and renovation to County Buildings. It is anticipated that an initial base contract will be negotiated with two or more teams of design professionals who are determined to be proposing the most qualified staff and offering the best value to the County. Inventory and documentation of existing space, which may include above ceiling, roof surfaces, behind floor ceiling and wall access panels, storage rooms, mechanical rooms, electrical and data closets etc. Facilities and building condition assessments to aid renovation design Programming, space planning and plan layouts, space needs and analysis (including potential swing space coordination) and test fits including potential leased space renovations and buildouts of previously unoccupied space(s) Obtaining approvals of government agencies having jurisdiction over the project. Renovation design including architectural, interior, plumbing, sprinkler, mechanical, electrical design and utility infrastructure (including coordination of related building components such as life safety, fire suppression, security and access controls) and potential site civil and landscape
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering
csv_comments: '- Project Number: 26-065- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 06/30/2026 05:00 PM EDT - Up to 2 and 4 contracts may be awarded
title: A/E Services for Wake County Building Renovations
short_description: Framework-style A/E services for renovation and fit-out of Wake County buildings.
project_location: Raleigh, Wake County, North Carolina, USA
project_scope: Architectural and engineering services for modifications and renovations to Wake County buildings, including inventory and documentation of existing spaces; condition assessments; programming; space planning; test fits; potential leased-space renovations; build-out of previously unoccupied spaces; approvals; and renovation design for architectural, interior, plumbing, sprinkler, mechanical, electrical, utility infrastructure, and possible site civil and landscape works. Stated total construction cost range per project/program: 100,000 to 8,000,000.
services: Architectural and engineering services for building renovations and refurbishments; inventory/documentation of existing conditions; facility assessments; programming; interior design and space planning; plan layouts; approvals coordination; and multidisciplinary renovation design including civil, electrical, plumbing, sprinkler, mechanical, and related building systems.
relevance_explanation:
- General building renovation framework for county buildings, not a specifically defined structurally demanding project.
- Focus is primarily architecture, interiors, MEP, and refurbishment rather than innovative structural engineering.
- Multiple-contract framework-style procurement reduces strategic relevance for sbp.
- No indication of long spans, special structures, bridges, stadiums, or architecturally exceptional buildings.
- Could include occasional civil/structural coordination, but structural scope is not central in the notice.
construction_cost_explanation: Tender states total construction cost range of 100,000 to 8,000,000; the upper stated project value is used as the plain-number construction cost reference.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee stated. Only construction cost range of 100,000 to 8,000,000 is provided; scope is a multi-award A/E services contract for various renovation projects, so a realistic sbp fee cannot be derived from the notice alone.
references_qualifications: Professional firms/teams must submit qualifications demonstrating the most qualified staff and best value for county building renovation A/E services. Specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are not stated in the source.
award_criteria: Most qualified staff and best value to the County; detailed weighting not stated in the source.
contracting_authority: Wake County Purchasing Department, Wake County, North Carolina, USA. Contact: Dave Delcambre. Phone: 919-856-6353. Fax: 919-856-6880. Email: david.delcambre@wake.gov. Website: https://www.wake.gov/departments-government/finance/current-business-opportunities
notes: Project No. 26-065. RFQ/RFP for county building renovations. Questions deadline: 2026-06-30 05:00 PM EDT. Source notes indicate up to 2 and 4 contracts may be awarded; wording is ambiguous. This appears to be an on-call or framework-like multi-project building renovation procurement rather than a single clearly defined building project.
